### Maintainer notes

PingScope is a self-contained bar widget that displays current ICMP latency for up to four user-configured hosts. It invokes the system `ping` command with IPv4 or IPv6, stores only widget settings in Omarchy's `shell.json`, and uses no credentials, downloads, telemetry, or privileged commands.
